limitations: One batched execution per version; no statistical or production-performance claim.
Exact model identifier, host tool version and resource budget were not exposed; not a strictly controlled causal benchmark.
Read lists are agent-reported, with material hashes independently checked. All project facts in the questions were hypothetical givens, not actual integrations or CI runs.
The two exact-wording regression tests guard known old formulations only; independent scenarios and audit assess policy meaning.
manual_assessment: Candidate answers matched the predeclared boundary expectations. Baseline retained cross-repository escalation and disclosed CI scope tension; these are observed case-level differences, not proof of general effectiveness or stable performance.

inputs.kind: synthetic rule reasoning; given facts are conditional inputs, not actual project verification
